newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat futures jump in distorted market-brokers.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat futures jump in distorted market-brokers.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures jumped sharply at the close on Wednesday in what brokers and traders said was a purposely distorted and over-priced market.
A rush of buying orders just before the closing bell pushed prices up by A$11.00 in trades on the September 1997 contract and by up to A$12.00 on the settlement price of September 1998.
Most settlement prices were up by about A$6.00 a tonne.
Brendan Hillary of ANZ Futures Ltd told Reuters that settlement prices overstated the market by about A$5.00 a tonne.
